issue.title: Jump to the last registered error with the ,L leader chord
issue.description: When a SASE agent launch (or chop) fails, the error toast names a leader chord, and pressing that chord opens the Admin Center Logs tab already scrolled to the exact log entry for that failure instead of leaving the user to hunt through log sources.

issue.title: Leader `,L` opens the Logs tab
issue.description: keymap: register the new `jump_to_last_error` leader action on `L` across the keymap dataclass, default config, dispatcher, command catalog, footer, help modal, and docs, with a first behavior that opens the Admin Center Logs tab.

issue.title: Registered errors and error-anchored launch logs
issue.description: registry: stamp every launch-failure log entry with a stable error id, add the session-scoped registered-error pointer, make one helper both register the error and emit its toast so the chord hint can never appear without a target, and make `,L` select the registered error's log source.

issue.title: Logs pane focuses the registered error entry
issue.description: focus: locate the registered error's anchor in a bounded tail scan, render a window containing it with the entry line highlighted, scroll the detail pane to it, and degrade with an in-pane notice when the entry has aged out.

Verified all three closed phases against source and commits d4f6535c4 (sase-qw.1), 422c8c2c5 (sase-qw.2), 3285244e3 (sase-qw.3).

Phase 1: jump_to_last_error is bound to leader L in LeaderModeKeymaps, default_config.yml, the leader dispatcher, _LEADER_LABELS, the footer, all three help-modal binding files, and all three docs/ace.md Leader Mode tables. log_panel stays in _RETIRED_LEADER_KEYS; the new action id does not resurrect it. ,L is global (no _LEADER_TABS restriction).

Phase 2: log_launch_failure mints/returns error_id, stamps it on the JSONL record and on the human header via shared error_anchor(); the three production call sites (payloadless launch-proc failure, chop exception, chop failure outcomes) thread that id through. failure_messages.py exposes only notify_registered_error (LOG_PANEL_HINT / with_log_panel_hint deleted). The src-wide guard test keeps the chord hint in exactly one file. Session pointer is in-memory, lock-guarded, no disk I/O. ,L with a registered error passes log_error_target; with none still opens Logs and notifies.

Phase 3: RegisteredError plumbs base.py -> ConfigCenterModal -> config_center_catalog -> LogsPane into the existing thread worker. render_focused_log_detail does a bounded 5000-line scan, last-occurrence match, separator-aligned window, inverse-gold anchor line, header focus suffix, and aged-out notice. Scroll is scheduled after layout; _error_target is cleared so r returns to the ordinary tail. docs/configuration.md documents session scope. PNG golden config_center_logs_tab_focused_error_120x40 covers the focused entry.

INTEGRATION. Re-checked later commits through HEAD 4f2581243. log_launch_failure still has exactly those three call sites. No post-epic src/ path emits a look-at-the-logs toast outside notify_registered_error. Hard-disabled provider abort (sase-qx.5) and Launch Control/Update-panel work are pre-submit UX, not launch-failure log writes, so they correctly do not register. Later keymap/docs work (e9ed6a350 ,U Update panel) preserved the ,L row; git diff 13365a95b..HEAD over logs/, failure_messages.py, logs_pane*.py, keymaps, and default_config.yml is empty except label/docs/Update-panel wiring that still lists jump_to_last_error.
